title: Malaysian Roti Canai
description: A traditional Malaysian flatbread recipe, often served with curry or dhal. Soft and flaky on the inside, crispy on the outside.
instructions: Mix flour and yeast in a large bowl.
Add warm water and knead for 10 minutes.
Cover and let rest for 1 hour.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten into a disk.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Cook each roti for 1-2 minutes on each side, until crispy and golden.
Brush with melted ghee or oil, if desired.
